source: data/catalog/items.json only (stats, aggression type and the game's effect text); rules in engine/src/item-tags.ts
note: Per completed item: gives = stat chips in one fixed order; does = how the passive/active works, from the fixed vocabulary in `does`; answers = the enemy problem it answers; unique = the item's own effect, condensed from the game text. roleLanguage[answer][role] phrases an answer for a lane; purpose = what the item is for when it answers nothing in particular, phrased by purposeLanguage[purpose][role], so every item has a line.

tanks.carry: Cuts down the front line you have to hit first
tanks.midlane: Keeps your combo hurting into stacked health
tanks.offlane: Wins the long trade against a tankier laner
tanks.jungle: Lets you kill their tank in objective fights
tanks.support: Helps your team burn through their front line

healing.carry: Cuts the healing on whoever you are hitting
healing.midlane: Stops them healing back through your combo
healing.offlane: Takes away the sustain that out-trades you in lane
healing.jungle: Makes ganks stick on targets that heal themselves
healing.support: Puts anti-heal on their healers for your whole team

shields.carry: Breaks the shields that soak your attacks
shields.midlane: Breaks the shield that eats your combo
shields.offlane: Punishes a laner who trades behind a shield
shields.jungle: Gets your gank damage through their shields
shields.support: Cracks enemy shields so your carry can finish

magic.carry: Lets you live through the magic combo aimed at you
magic.midlane: Survive the enemy mid in a magic matchup
magic.offlane: Holds the lane against a magic damage laner
magic.jungle: Lets you dive into their mages and walk out
magic.support: Keeps you standing in front against magic damage

physical.carry: Buys time against the assassin or carry on you
physical.midlane: Survive the physical jungler and assassin dives
physical.offlane: Holds the lane against a physical damage laner
physical.jungle: Lets you fight their carry and physical jungler
physical.support: Keeps you standing in front against their carry

cc.carry: Shortens the lockdown that kills you before you attack
cc.midlane: Gets you out of the stun that sets up their kill
cc.offlane: Keeps you moving through their crowd control in fights
cc.jungle: Lets you finish a dive through their crowd control
cc.support: Keeps you free to peel when they chain crowd control

burst.carry: Saves you from the one combo that deletes you
burst.midlane: Survive the all-in from their assassin or jungler
burst.offlane: Gives you a second wind when a dive goes long
burst.jungle: Lets you go in first and survive the reply
burst.support: Survive being the first target of their engage

crit.carry: Blunts the enemy carry in the late duel
crit.midlane: Takes the sting out of their crit carry
crit.offlane: Lets you dive a crit carry and live
crit.jungle: Lets you jump their crit carry and live
crit.support: Stand in front of their crit carry for longer

support.carry: Stronger heals and shields for the team around you
support.midlane: Stronger heals and shields from your abilities
support.offlane: Stronger heals and shields in the fight you start
support.jungle: Stronger heals and shields on the allies you gank for
support.support: Stronger heals and shields on the carry you protect

crit.carry: Bigger crits for the late-game team fights
crit.midlane: Crit damage for a mid who wins with basic attacks
crit.offlane: Crit damage to win the long duel
crit.jungle: Crit damage to clear camps and duel faster
crit.support: Crit damage if you are playing for kills

onhit.carry: More attacks, and each one hits harder
onhit.midlane: Basic attacks that add to your combo
onhit.offlane: Faster attacks for long trades in lane
onhit.jungle: Faster attacks for camps and sticking to a target
onhit.support: Faster attacks to add damage from the front

burst.carry: Finishes low targets before they get away
burst.midlane: More damage in the one combo that gets the kill
burst.offlane: Turns a won trade into a kill
burst.jungle: More damage up front on a gank
burst.support: Adds kill damage to the pick you start

sustain.carry: Heals you back while you keep attacking
sustain.midlane: Heals you back as your abilities land
sustain.offlane: Lets you stay in lane through trades
sustain.jungle: Keeps you healthy between camps and fights
sustain.support: Keeps you alive while you stand in front

mobility.carry: Speed to kite and keep your spacing
mobility.midlane: Speed to roam and dodge abilities
mobility.offlane: Speed to stick to a target or get out
mobility.jungle: Speed to reach ganks and objectives first
mobility.support: Speed to reach the fight and your carry

control.carry: Slows what you hit so it cannot reach you
control.midlane: Holds targets so the rest of your combo lands
control.offlane: Holds targets so they cannot leave the trade
control.jungle: Holds targets so the gank sticks
control.support: Holds targets so your team can catch them

area.carry: Hits everything near your target and clears waves
area.midlane: Clears waves fast so you can roam
area.offlane: Clears waves fast and hits grouped enemies
area.jungle: Clears camps faster and hits grouped enemies
area.support: Adds area damage around the fight you start

cooldowns.midlane: Abilities back sooner for a second combo
cooldowns.offlane: Abilities back sooner in long fights
cooldowns.jungle: Abilities back sooner for the next gank
cooldowns.support: Abilities back sooner to peel and engage again

scaling.carry: Grows as you farm: strongest late
scaling.midlane: Grows as you farm and get takedowns
scaling.offlane: Grows through the lane: strongest late
scaling.jungle: Grows as you clear camps and get takedowns
scaling.support: Grows over the game, so buy it early

durable.carry: Extra toughness so one mistake does not kill you
durable.midlane: Extra toughness to survive being jumped
durable.offlane: Makes you harder to kill in long fights
durable.jungle: Makes you harder to kill when you go in first
durable.support: Makes you harder to kill at the front

mana.carry: Mana to keep using abilities in lane
mana.midlane: Mana to keep casting through the lane
mana.offlane: Mana to keep trading with abilities
mana.jungle: Mana to keep clearing with abilities
mana.support: Mana to keep healing and poking in lane

power.carry: Raw damage on every attack and ability
power.midlane: Raw power: every ability hits harder
power.jungle: Raw damage for ganks and camps
power.support: Raw damage if your team needs more from you
